title: Auritus as an embeddable speech library
description:
## Purpose
As a host application (first consumer: **Apricity**, for its generated voice layer), I want to call Auritus as a clean, typed, offline speech library, so that I get real speech audio plus metadata without running the cloud service.

## Not included
Singing, melody, pitch or timing control. This is speech only.

## Definition of Done
- `from auritus import synthesize, Voice, SpeechOptions` works offline, returns `Speech` (wav, sample_rate, duration, segments, provenance) and gives a stable `request_key`.
- No silent test-tone fallbacks: a missing backend raises `BackendUnavailable`.
- Voice lookup is explicit (`voices_dir` or `AURITUS_VOICES`), with no cwd or `/app` search.
- `auritus speak` and `auritus voices` work without AWS or login.
- The worker image reuses `auritus.tts` instead of its own copy.
- Per-backend pip extras; `auritus.tts` imports without the CLI or AWS dependencies.
- Non-commercial backends are refused unless opted in.
- All specs green (`make check`).
